zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Mahwah Township Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.18%, with an equalization ratio of 82.1%.

Average residential assessment is $558,280, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,170.5.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Mahwah Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,170.5 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.29% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 82.1%, assessed values average ~82.1% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 57.6% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.4%, and Bergen County claims 11.0%.
